findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: One dead mouse was observed in the upstairs bar area in a space where a cooler was recently removed. The facility was observed otherwise free of evidence of pests or harborage conditions. Facility has routine pest control providing service monthly and is attentive to cleaning processes. The mouse was removed and the surrounding floor will be cleaned. Glasses stored in the adjacent space were removed to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Continue routine pest control and cleaning. Inspect facility regularly to monitor for pest activity.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed there is a buildup of frost on the white reach-in freezers in the downstairs main kitchen. The freezers must be defrosted at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of frost. Ensure that the freezers are defrosted to make smooth, easily cleanable surfaces by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there is an accumulation of dust on the walk-in cooler fans. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the fans are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Ensure the following physical facilities are maintained in good repair:

(1) The holes in the wall behind the triple sink and hand washing sink outside the employee bathroom must be sealed (ex.caulking). 
(2) The foam caulking on the baseboards at the downstairs bar that is bubbled must be cut flush to the wall and pained/sealed. 
(3) The gap between the stainless steel wall and wood frame behind the dry storage tubs in the main kitchen must be sealed/repaired.
(4) The broken piece of plastic on the lid of the ice machine must be sealed/repaired. 
(5) The ends of the dry storage selves that have peeling paint must be sealed (ex.repainted). 
(6) The water damage on the ceiling of the employee bathroom must be repaired. 

Ensure that all physical facilities are repaired to make smooth, easily cleanable surfaces by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the dish machine was reading at 0 ppm (Cl) during the inspection. The PIC called for immediate service and a maintenance personal arrived during the inspection. The maintenance personal said the bottle was exposed for a significant amount of time causing the sanitizer to loose its strength. An employee replaced the sanitizer bottle during the inspection. The dish machine was testing at 100 ppm (Cl) after replacing the bottle. Ensure the sanitizer bottle is always sealed and the dish machine is tested on a regular basis. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10).
